**MagicMap 2.1.1.** For WoW Forever's live client, build 1.60.1.70790.

- **The map art repairs show again.** The game's patch to 70790 turned them off (they only draw on a build they've been checked against). Their tiles are unchanged in 70790, so they're back on.
- **Data from 70790:** one flight path link the patch removed is gone from routes. Everything else is the same as 2.1.0.

### Install
1. Download `MagicMap-v2.1.1.zip` below, or update from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/magic-map).
2. Unzip it into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the old `MagicMap` folder.
3. Restart the game. Your settings are kept.

Everything in 2.1: [the 2.1.0 notes](https://github.com/benmills/MagicMap/releases/tag/v2.1.0).
